verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents OAuth token generation and distinguishes credential privilege levels: some endpoints explicitly 'require a company admin API key', which implies non-admin keys with lesser privilege. That points to some scoping of API credentials, but there is no explicit documentation of granular scopes or least-privilege key issuance for an agent. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-key permission selection, guidance on issuing restricted credentials to agents or service accounts, key rotation/revocation details, and independent corroboration.
